source.title: Leveraging Nutrient-Rich Traditional Foods to Improve Diets among Indigenous Populations in India: Value Chain Analysis of Finger Millet and Kionaar Leaves

locators: PMC9736962, Methods section 2.1: exploratory study with two value-chain case studies; finger millet case situated in a Munda community
PMC9736962, Methods section 2.4: in-person semi-structured interviews January-April 2022; 12 interviews for the Munda finger-millet case; purposive selection based on finger-millet farming experience

PMC9736962, Methods ethics paragraph: institutional ethics approvals, administrative approvals, cluster-level village-leader consent, and individual written or witnessed verbal consent documented by the article
exact_locator_evidence.claim_boundary: The record may state only what the article documents about its own study design, sample and methods. It must not convert interview content into generalized Munda cultural facts.

excluded_from_promotion: substantive cultural claims derived from interviews
universal claims about Munda food practice
third-party images or materials without item-level rights review
